# Changelog — Shared expenses

## 0.4.0

- Tips on every page: how to see the details, how to add and how to change. Turn them on or off with 💡 at the top; the choice is kept on this device.

## 0.3.1

- The row of tabs no longer shows a small scroll bar when all tabs fit; it scrolls sideways only when they do not.

## 0.3.0

- The app is now also in Italian and Spanish: pick the language at the top of the page.

## 0.2.0

- Utility bills and shopping lists can now add expenses to your groups: a bill with everyone’s exact share, or what was bought on a list, split equally. Adding the same bill or list twice changes nothing, and the expense shows where it came from with a link back.

## 0.1.0

- Groups for trips, flats, couples and events, in one currency. Invite people with a link, a code or a QR code: they join at once and get the app free. Add friends from DevQuake, or people without an account by name.
- Expenses: what, how much, who paid, the day and a category, split equally, by shares, by percent or by exact amounts. Everyone's part is shown as you type and kept exact to the cent.
- Balances, and the fewest transfers to settle up; record payments with one tap.
- Comments on expenses, an activity feed of every change, and statistics by category, by month and by person.
